Kitcoin
Like Dogecoin, but for cats!

https://t.co/88lNclgmtr https://t.co/7Y7EGrwVey

Kitcoin, launched in 2014, was created as a direct rival to Dogecoin.

It was advertised as Dogecoin and Bitcoin, but for cats.

https://t.co/4AKoey6GYy

This is a forgotten currency that had real potential to rival dogecoin.
